items.title: Billie Pierce and De De Pierce Interview, 1959-10-07
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] I went in there with Walter Pichon too... [INTERVIEWEE] Yeah, I worked there.

ctx.x: Who was in Piron's band now? Well, nobody but just Piron and I. Piron and I. Piron and Vowler. That's all I was working in the absence bar.
I went in there with Walter Pichon too. I went there with him from the other times and other things I did.
They never had much of a band. It's more just for entertaining people to come in sightseeing around, you know. But you played there, Diddy, huh? Yeah, I worked there.
